title: Creator Status Datapack!
description: The Creator Status mod, but as a datapack!
body:
This Datapack adds the Creator Status mod, but in Datapack form!This requires players to not install the actual mod, and makes it easier to ensure all players have the creator status installed.

No more excuses for people "not having the mod".

**You need this resource pack for it to function properly:** https://github.com/zskv-coding/status-rp/releases/tag/26.1.2

How to use:

Click the "G" button (can be changed by changing the "Quick Actions" keybind).
Select your appearance
Hit "Confirm"!

This pack also auto marks players as AFK after 30 seconds!
